name: com.notacompany/newsletter
title: The notacompany newsletter
description: Follow the money. Skip the noise. The startups VCs just backed, curated by Tiago.

tools.name: list_picks
tools.description: List the picks (the startups VCs just backed, and the products and reads Tiago keeps), newest first: filter by category, tag, source, or date. Each carries why_picked, Tiago's words on why he picked it, and its page_url. A curator may pass status to list pending or rejected ones. Subscribers only: sign in through this server's OAuth.

tag.description: A tag's slug or any of its spellings.

status.description: pending or rejected need a curator.

tools.name: get_pick
tools.description: Get a pick by slug (a former slug resolves too), with why_picked and its page_url. A subscriber sees published picks only; a curator sees any. Subscribers only: sign in through this server's OAuth.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the picks' tags, most-used first, with counts and each tag's slug: the tag list_picks filters on, and what a collection's rule names. Returns the top 50 unless limit says otherwise; query keeps the tags whose name or slug contains it. meta.total_count is how many tags matched, and page reads on past the first limit of them. Subscribers only: sign in through this server's OAuth.

query.description: Part of a tag's name or slug, any case: "capital", "100m".

page.description: The next limit of tags, so the whole list can be read.

tools.name: list_pending_bookmarks
tools.description: List pending bookmarks for curation, newest first. Curator only.

tools.name: approve_bookmarks
tools.description: Approve up to 100 bookmarks by slug and publish them. Approving a rejected bookmark restores it. All or nothing: if any slug is not found, nothing changes and the error names the missing slugs. Curator only.

tools.name: reject_bookmarks
tools.description: Reject up to 100 bookmarks by slug, all with the same optional reason; send one call per reason. They stay stored and can be approved later. All or nothing: if any slug is not found, nothing changes and the error names the missing slugs. Curator only.

tools.name: create_bookmark
tools.description: Create a bookmark. It starts pending; approve it to publish. Needs a title and a url or source_url. The slug is derived from the title unless given. Curator only.

url.description: Where the bookmark points. ?ref=notacompany is added on the way out and stripped on the way in.

source_url.description: The article or announcement, when it differs from url.

one_liner.description: A company's name, a spaced em dash, and what it makes, for whom ("Peppermint — Billing and collections for clinical trial sites"); an issue prints it as the item's title, the name in bold, with the round under it. No amount, no investors. Written on approval when left blank.

note.description: Tiago's take: his one-line note on the bookmark.

cover_url.description: Found from the destination's og:image on approval when left out.

tag_groups.description: Tags in their display spelling ("Sands Capital", "$100M+"), grouped.

amount.description: A raise's amount in USD cents.

batch.description: An accelerator batch as the accelerator spells it: "Summer 2026" (YC), "SR007" (a16z speedrun).

published_at.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime; defaults to now on create.

hidden.description: Hidden bookmarks stay approved but leave the public feed.

tools.name: update_bookmark
tools.description: Change a bookmark's fields; omitted fields keep their value. tag_groups merges by group: a group you send replaces that group, an empty list removes it, and groups you leave out are kept. new_slug renames it, and the old slug keeps resolving. Curator only.

new_slug.description: Rename the bookmark's URL; the old slug becomes an alias.

url.description: Where the bookmark points. ?ref=notacompany is added on the way out and stripped on the way in.

source_url.description: The article or announcement, when it differs from url.

one_liner.description: A company's name, a spaced em dash, and what it makes, for whom ("Peppermint — Billing and collections for clinical trial sites"); an issue prints it as the item's title, the name in bold, with the round under it. No amount, no investors. Written on approval when left blank.

note.description: Tiago's take: his one-line note on the bookmark.

cover_url.description: Found from the destination's og:image on approval when left out.

tag_groups.description: Tags in their display spelling ("Sands Capital", "$100M+"), grouped.

amount.description: A raise's amount in USD cents.

batch.description: An accelerator batch as the accelerator spells it: "Summer 2026" (YC), "SR007" (a16z speedrun).

published_at.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime; defaults to now on create.

hidden.description: Hidden bookmarks stay approved but leave the public feed.

tools.name: delete_bookmark
tools.description: Permanently delete a bookmark and its slug aliases, so its old URLs return 404. Call only after the user has confirmed this exact bookmark by title and slug. To take a bookmark off the site and keep it, use reject_bookmarks. Curator only.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the pages that list bookmarks (YC batches, speedrun cohorts, /startups pages), each with its rule, its copy and how many bookmarks it holds. Public callers see published pages; a curator sees drafts and retired pages too, with status, target_query and a preview_url for each page not yet published. Subscribers only: sign in through this server's OAuth.

status.description: draft or retired need a curator.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Draft a new collection page. It is always a draft, seen only at its preview_url until publish_collection. kind is yc_batch (rule {batch: "Fall 2026"}), speedrun_cohort (rule {batch: "SR008"}), startups (rule {tags: [slug, ...], category?}, any of the tags, or {stage: "series_b", category?}, every round at that stage: one of pre_seed, seed, series_a, series_b, series_c, series_d, growth; tags and stage never go together) or category (rule {category: value}; every category already has one). Every page is served at /collections/{slug}; slug is the words people search for it by ("yc-fall-2026", "robotics-startups"), unique across collections. A startups or category page needs its own title, h1, lead and description; a batch or cohort may leave them blank for its template. {count}, {first} and {latest} fill in, and {batch} on a batch. target_query is the one search the page is written for, unique across collections. controls says what the page offers over its cards: search (true/false), filters (any of topic, investor, stage), sorts (one or more of newest, biggest, the page's own order first) and group (day or none); a key left out keeps its default ({"search":false,"filters":[],"sorts":["newest","biggest"],"group":"none"}). Curator only.

slug.description: The page's address, /collections/{slug}: lowercase words joined by hyphens, as people search for it ("yc-fall-2026", "a16z-speedrun-sr008", "defense-tech-startups").

batch.description: A YC batch ("Fall 2026") or a speedrun cohort ("SR008").

tags.description: Tag slugs from list_tags; a bookmark carrying any of them is in.

stage.description: One round stage, on a startups page built on a stage ("series_b" for Series B startups); sent without tags.

controls.description: What the page offers over its cards; a key left out keeps its default.

group.description: day groups the cards by the day each was logged.

description.description: The meta description, at most 160 characters.

target_query.description: The one search this page is written for.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Change a draft collection's rule, copy, controls or target_query; omitted fields keep their value, and an empty string clears a field back to its template. A published page's words and controls are changed in Avo. Curator only.

slug.description: The page's address, /collections/{slug}: lowercase words joined by hyphens, as people search for it ("yc-fall-2026", "a16z-speedrun-sr008", "defense-tech-startups").

batch.description: A YC batch ("Fall 2026") or a speedrun cohort ("SR008").

tags.description: Tag slugs from list_tags; a bookmark carrying any of them is in.

stage.description: One round stage, on a startups page built on a stage ("series_b" for Series B startups); sent without tags.

controls.description: What the page offers over its cards; a key left out keeps its default.

group.description: day groups the cards by the day each was logged.

description.description: The meta description, at most 160 characters.

target_query.description: The one search this page is written for.

tools.name: publish_collection
tools.description: Publish a draft collection: it is indexed, sitemapped and announced to search engines. A curator may publish a draft on its own once it passes the gate and its list fits its name; retiring or renaming a live page stays with Tiago. Refused below 10 bookmarks under its rule, for a category or startups page without its own title, h1, lead and description, and for a startups page without its target_query or with a live page on the same rule. Curator only.

slug.description: The page's address, /collections/{slug}: lowercase words joined by hyphens, as people search for it ("yc-fall-2026", "a16z-speedrun-sr008", "defense-tech-startups").

tools.name: newsletter_stats
tools.description: The newsletter's subscriber counts, as totals only: no email address and no single subscriber's row. Returns subscribers (active = confirmed and still subscribed, pending = waiting on the confirmation link, unsubscribed), agent_inboxes (active and pending readers whose address is at an inbox built for agents: agentmail.to), active_by_source (the signup form: subscribe, footer, bookmarks, home, collection, archive, agent, mcp, unknown), and over the last `days` (default 28, at most 365, UTC, today included): confirmed.total, confirmed.daily (one row a day), confirmed.by_landing_path (the page the form was on, top 50), confirmed.by_utm_source (the utm_source of the link that brought the reader, read from the first page of their visit, else from the page the form was on), confirmed.by_referrer (the site that linked to the first page of the visit), confirmed.by_channel (one per reader: an agent's signup as “agent (MCP)” or “agent (form)”, else the campaign tag, else the referring site), confirmed.by_source (the signup form or door), confirmed.heard_from (the answers to “How did you hear about us?”, given after confirming, counted by answer) unsubscribes, and blocked_signups (signups the form's browser check refused, total and by day, no address kept). (none) counts rows with no value; (other) counts values that are no page address or campaign token. Curator only.

days.description: The window in days, today included (UTC).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a company Tiago picked, by its slug (the last part of its page, /market/companies/{slug}): its facts, each with the page it came from, its latest round's investors and lead, and why_picked, Tiago's own words on why he picked it. Picks only. Subscribers only: sign in through this server's OAuth.

tools.name: get_investor
tools.description: Get an investor by its slug (/market/investors/{slug}): the companies Tiago picked from its rounds, never its whole portfolio, each with whether it led and why it was picked. Subscribers only: sign in through this server's OAuth.

tools.name: update_company
tools.description: Change a picked company's profile: its facts (a list replacing the stored one, each {key, value, url?, source_url}), its website, its contact_email (kept for Tiago, never shown) or its slug (new_slug: the old one keeps resolving). Curator only.

new_slug.description: Rename the page's address; the old slug 301s to the new one.

key.description: makes, audience, model, status, founded, headquarters, team_size, founder, lead_investor, or link:product|docs|pricing|careers|launch|press|linkedin|x|github|app_store|play_store|accelerator

source_url.description: The page the fact is on.

tools.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to The notacompany newsletter, Tiago's newsletter: the startups VCs just backed, curated by Tiago. Five minutes every weekday to see where tech is heading. Call it only with an address its owner asked you to sign up. It sends that address a confirmation link, and the subscription starts only when its owner clicks it (double opt-in), so tell them to look for the email from Tiago Martins. The answer is the same whether or not the address was already on the list. The RSS feed at https://www.notacompany.com/archive/rss needs no email at all.

email.description: The address to send the confirmation link to, given by its owner.
